authorial_core.interpreted_intent: Surreal level three leads through one continuous locomotive changing impossibly from miniature inside a matchbox to room-sized outside. Current text sets surreal strength; prior context authorizes an independent random concept with supplied portrait appearance. Before freeze I replaced a liquid-material idea to maintain independent diversity across arms, without seeing another arm. Within the new direction I compared a giant floating object with scale transformation at a handheld boundary: the latter gives a specific contact, continuity and already-visible consequence. Room, woman, matchbox and train remain authorial staging rather than user locks. Sensual one supports the warm intimate presence, fetish zero adds no focus, creativity one permits restrained later refinement.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A surreal photograph of a subject inhabiting impossible physical reality, where ordinary scale has visibly changed. In a quiet sunlit room, one woman holds open a tiny matchbox while an enormous old steam locomotive emerges from it. Use the supplied portrait as a visible appearance guide for her face, dark short bob and fine wispy bangs. Her softly parted lips and intent, affectionate concentration give this impossible discovery a warm intimate presence. She wears a faded cream linen dress. The huge black iron locomotive fills the lower two-thirds of the landscape frame, its round boiler front nearly as high as the woman's shoulders, its wheels resting on the parquet floor close to the camera. Its long body narrows impossibly as it curves upward and backward into the tiny open matchbox held beside her waist. The metal boiler, wheels and two rails remain one continuously visible three-dimensional construction across the abrupt change of scale. At the box's open end, a miniature section of railway is visibly inside the cardboard tray; the same two rails cross the thin cardboard lip and rapidly spread to full railway gauge just outside it. The engine's small rear section is visibly passing through that opening while its large front section already occupies the room. The cardboard lip lies clearly in front of the small metal section, with a narrow shadow at their crossing, so the boundary reads as physical passage. Black iron, small brass rivets and rails share the same surface detail across both scales. She stands behind and slightly left of the engine, with her face unobstructed above it. Her left palm supports the underside of the matchbox tray and her right thumb and fingers hold its sleeve aside, leaving the opening fully visible. Both elbows remain near her torso. Both feet are planted apart on clear parquet beside the rails. Her eyes follow the crossing at the matchbox lip. Pale wall, single window and ordinary wooden chair stay quiet around the immense engine, establishing room scale. Warm side light illuminates her face, hands and cardboard, then rakes the locomotive's iron and its grounded wheel shadows. Photograph at chest height from a front three-quarter angle, wide enough to include both hands, the full matchbox-to-engine connection, the boiler front, both feet and floor space. Believable photographic surface texture, fine analog grain, restrained warm color. The impossible continuous expansion from matchbox to room-sized train dominates the whole photograph.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request, including the depth of candidate-informed reconstruction after the independent baseline is frozen. It changes exploration and authorial reconstruction, not requester ownership or candidate-adoption quotas.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image. After retrieval, retain candidate-informed changes only when needed for faithful meaning, legibility or consistency; do not expand the scene merely to use material.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction. After retrieval, consider local additions, replacements or subtractions with a concrete expressive benefit, keeping the overall direction close to the request.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction. After retrieval, develop candidate-informed alternatives that reorganize connected authorial choices, including replacement and subtraction rather than only local additions.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving every requester requirement. After retrieval, actively develop whole-photograph reconstructions from that required meaning and compatible candidate material, substantially replacing agent-authored staging when it serves the requested freedom. Do not limit exploration to fixing the baseline or prescribe a minimum adoption count or rewrite percentage.
